answer: What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the sonnet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the spiral re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short.
